description: Launch or deep-link into a channel on the Roku device. Use appId "dev" for the sideloaded developer channel.

appId.description: Application ID to launch (use "dev" for the sideloaded channel)

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

params.description: Optional launch parameters for deep linking (key-value pairs)

restart.description: Exit the app first (ECP exit-app, falling back to Home) and wait ~1.5s. Channels with sdk_instant_resume only suspend on exit and will resume, not cold-start; use roku_deploy for a guaranteed cold start

name: roku_launch
